title: NightLock
description: "Locks" the day cycle during a configurable time of day and/or night.
body:
## Overview  
Prevents the daylight cycle from progressing once a certain time of day or night is reached, requiring the player/players to sleep in order to progress the time. Best paired with a mod or modpack that requires the player to find a safe place to sleep or otherwise set up camp for the night.

 

## Configuration  
Can be located in nightlock-server.toml  
**nightLock**: Whether to stop time progressing during the night. Default on.  
**dayLock**: Whether to stop time progressing during the day. Default off.  
**nightLockTime**: What time to lock the night at. Defaults to Midnight.  
**dayLockTime**: What time to lock the day at. Defaults to Noon.  

 

## Ports
Will only happen to the latest "community consensus" version of Minecraft mods are made for, at my discretion.
